svg.text: Solid crow's-foot line: foreign key in pricing_db. Dashed line: the value is copied into the snapshot, so closing a rate card never changes an issued quote.

svg.text: QUOTE_SNAPSHOT is stored in Redis under an opaque UUID with a 15-minute TTL (swiftdrop.pricing.quote-ttl) and returned verbatim.
